Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-screen background illustration for an original 3D adventure game TITLE MENU, landscape 16:9.
Create a premium stylized 3D game key-art environment: a vast ancient forest valley with monumental weathered stone arches, stepped bridges over turquoise water, waterfalls, glowing cyan Echo runes, lush broad leaves and golden late-afternoon sun. Lively, inviting, colourful and adventurous. High-quality sculpted materials, detailed moss and foliage, atmospheric depth, vivid emerald, deep turquoise, warm orange highlights. Bold beautiful silhouettes, appealing console platformer aesthetics, sophisticated lighting and depth.
Composition: wide low camera. The right half contains the main vista and enormous sweeping ancient arch framed by leaves; a small mossy stone ledge in the lower right foreground has room for a character that will be composited separately. The leftmost 42 percent is a quieter, darker teal area of soft foliage and atmospheric forest, with no focal objects, left deliberately readable for a large title and vertical menu supplied separately in HTML. Top left should be relatively dark. The image fills the entire screen, absolutely no UI panels, no card layout, no title text, no writing, no logo, no watermark, no character, no screenshot frame. Never copy any existing game scene. Energetic full-bleed game art, not a webpage design.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL game mascot cutout for a full-screen adventure game title menu. Transparent background.
Create Nori, a small charming original fantasy adventurer creature, full body, facing camera in a dynamic confident three-quarter pose, cream-white softly textured fur, long broad expressive teal-tipped ears swept upward and slightly outward, a big pair of glossy dark expressive eyes with clear golden highlights, tiny dark nose, subtle cheek freckles, smile with one tiny tooth. Short rounded limbs and large cute paws, modest foxlike fluffy teal-tipped tail curled behind the body. Distinct bright coral-red scarf with long fluttering ends, little weathered brown adventure backpack. It is NOT orange, NOT wearing shorts or sneakers, NOT a bandicoot, not any existing game mascot. Cute but capable, a little mischievous, adventurous rather than babyish.
Pose: leaning eagerly forward as if about to leap toward an ordinary slice of cake, right paw extended palm up toward the viewer, other paw near backpack strap. Strong readable silhouette, ears and scarf fully inside image, full feet visible. Large face and readable eyes. Sophisticated premium stylized 3D game render, detailed groomed fur but sculptural clean shapes, tactile cloth scarf. Lighting: warm golden sunlight upper left, turquoise soft fill lower right. Cheerful saturated colour, crisp silhouette. Isolated with genuine transparent alpha, no ground plane, no scene, no text, no drop-shadow box, no logo, no checkerboard. Portrait composition with ample edge margin.

purpose: Original layered title-menu illustration. Not an Unreal gameplay screenshot or finished 3D character asset.
